title: Graphic Design — Objective Assessment
description: Module 1 & Module 2 objective assessment. 15 multiple-choice questions.
instructions: Answer all 15 questions. Select the most appropriate answer from the options provided. Multiple-choice questions are marked automatically when you submit.

questions.prompt: What is the primary function of visual hierarchy in a design?
options: To arrange elements alphabetically
To guide viewers on what to notice first and where to look next
To ensure that every element receives equal attention
To make all sections of a design visually identical

questions.prompt: Which software is the primary tool for the Smartphone Graphic Design track?
options: Adobe Photoshop
Canva
PixelLab
Adobe Illustrator

questions.prompt: What does the 60/30/10 rule mean in colour palette design?
options: Using three colours equally in a design
Using 60% primary colour, 30% secondary colour, and 10% accent colour
Using 60% accent colour, 30% primary colour, and 10% secondary colour
Using only three shades of the same colour

questions.prompt: According to the typography lesson, why should designers avoid forcing paragraphs into justified alignment when it creates unwanted gaps?
options: Justified text cannot be used in graphic design
It makes the font weight too heavy
Large or awkward spaces can disrupt the natural reading flow
It prevents designers from using a grid

questions.prompt: A designer notices that a poster looks cluttered and uncomfortable to read. Which adjustment would most likely improve the composition?
options: Adding more decorative elements
Making every text element bold
Increasing the white space between content elements
Removing all margins from the design

questions.prompt: What is the primary purpose of learning the Lightroom Mobile interface?
options: To understand where its major controls and features are located
To replace PixelLab completely
To learn professional video editing
To create vector illustrations

questions.prompt: What should you consider when choosing text and background colours?
options: Whether the colours make the text difficult to read
Whether the text and background have exactly the same colour
Whether the background is brighter than every other element
Whether the design contains as many colours as possible

questions.prompt: In the typography lesson, a designer uses a heading size of 75 points and divides it by 5 to determine the body text size. What is the resulting body text size?
options: 10 points
15 points
25 points
35 points

questions.prompt: Why is consistent alignment important in a design?
options: It makes every object identical in appearance.
It helps the composition look organised and easier to navigate.
It ensures that all text is centre-aligned.
It eliminates the need for white space.

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of becoming familiar with design software at this stage of the course?
options: To master every available design tool immediately
To become comfortable with the software's interface and working environment
To begin creating professional client projects
To learn how to use every feature before learning design principles

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of an accent colour in a design?
options: To fill every empty space
To replace the primary colour
To make all text appear the same
To draw attention to important elements, such as call-to-action buttons

questions.prompt: How can lines and shapes help improve the organisation of typography in a design?
options: By making every text element the same size
By visually separating and grouping related text elements
By replacing all headings with decorative symbols
By forcing every paragraph into the centre of the layout

questions.prompt: A designer wants an important announcement to catch the viewer's attention immediately. Which technique would best help achieve this?
options: Making every element the same size and colour
Placing all elements close together
Using contrast to make the announcement stand out
Removing the visual hierarchy from the design

questions.prompt: Which of the following best demonstrates the principle of repetition?
options: Using a different font style for every heading
Placing unrelated elements next to each other
Using the same colour palette and header style throughout a project
Making the main headline smaller than the supporting text

questions.prompt: Why should designers test different colour combinations before finalising a design?
options: To ensure the design uses at least ten colours
To make every colour equally prominent
To eliminate the need for visual hierarchy
To check readability, contrast, and how well the colours work together
